title: Complementary Constant Assignments
statement: Let $P$ be a finite constraint instance over $mathbb{F}_2$ whose constraints are equations on three pairwise-distinct variables, with at least one constraint and every variable occurring in some constraint. For each constraint, satisfaction means that the sum of its three assigned values equals its right-hand side. The total numbers of satisfied constraints under the assignments that give every variable $0$ and every variable $1$ sum to the total number of constraints, counted with multiplicity.
